svg.title: DRAFT: Restart seat exchange, negotiate disruption inside a fixed maintenance budget
svg.desc: Illustrative, non-interactive concept. A desktop window permits two unavailable workstations. Studio-17 and studio-18 occupy its two proposed restart seats. Studio-17 has requested a later turn, and studio-22 is a candidate replacement whose employee preference is still pending. The operator previews swapping those two devices without adding a seat or issuing a reboot. A separate server pool is blocked because drain evidence for build-02 is unknown. The proposed next action asks for the desktop preference; this neither reserves a seat nor authorizes a restart. A final exchange would require atomic server revalidation, eligibility, current inhibitors, and applicable approval. Restart interrupts applications and cannot undo unsaved work. Seat records, employee negotiation and atomic exchange are proposed backend work.

g.text: LINDM / CONCEPT 04 / DRAFT OWNER SELECTION / ILLUSTRATIVE DATA
Trade a restart turn, not a larger outage
Desktop maintenance · 12 Oct, 18:00–19:00 Europe/London · Two unavailable at most
Current proposed seats
SEAT 1
studio-17

Request is a preference, not an approved deferral or permission to miss the deadline

studio-18

One-for-one exchange proposal
studio-17 leaves seat 1
Later turn: not yet reserved
Keep current turn until a valid exchange is accepted
studio-22 could take seat 1
Employee preference: pending
Eligibility and inhibitors must be checked again
No extra seat
Server pool is separate: build-02 is blocked
Drain evidence: unknown. Health evidence must be current before a server seat can be used.
An employee preference or a free desktop seat never satisfies a server's availability prerequisites.
Next: ask for a preference, not permission to reboot
Request studio-22's employee preference. This changes no reservation and sends no restart.
A final exchange must revalidate both devices, the later turn, deadlines and the capacity budget.
Any later restart interrupts applications; unsaved work cannot be restored by cancelling afterward.
Request studio-22's time preference
Keep both current turns
Existing policy fields are constraints, not a reservation API. Required authorization and approval remain in force.
PROPOSED: expiring seats + employee negotiation + atomic exchange. Static sketch, no controls are operable.
